sources.snippet: We introduce Olmo 3, a family of state-of-the-art, fully-open language models at the 7B and 32B parameter scales. Olmo 3 model construction targets long-context reasoning, function calling, coding, instruction following, general chat, and knowledge recall. sources.snippet: Olmo3 7B by AllenAI AllenAI introduces Olmo 3, a new family of 7B and 32B models. This suite includes Base, Instruct, and Think variants.
